messages:
mira: Quick follow-up to the allocator split RFC. did a small repro and am worried about delayed placement causing p99 regressions for tiny batches.

mira: proposal recap: keep alloc() cheap, separate residency_manager for placement/eviction. alloc returns a handle; residency operations can be sync (ensure_resident) or hint/defer.

tariq: iirc the main risk is the async hop increasing tail latency. any numbers?

mira: microbench results: monolith p50=1.1ms p99=11.8ms. with residency_manager fast-path p50=1.2ms p99=12.6ms. with async-hint only p99 ~24ms on small-batch fixture.

jon: doubling p99 sucks but could be acceptable if we give callers a sync API. Maybe ensure_resident(handle, mode="sync|hint|defer") returns immediately for hint/defer and blocks for sync.

mira: yep. also need a cheap handle->gpu_ptr path for hot kernels. i propose handles are either immediate pointers or small indirection indexes. residency_manager maintains an atomic indirection table in shared memory updated on promotions.

evan: who makes eviction choices? tenant or platform? and how do we avoid thrash when watermarks move?

tariq: platform should own global eviction heuristics. tenants can provide soft hints like affinity or lifetime. residency_manager should subscribe to host-pool watermarks and use backpressure tokens to avoid thrash.

mira: split concern: we currently store eviction metadata on allocation descriptors. if we separate, we need an idempotent mapping and GC for residency entries so we don't leak stale slots. also need fast path for resident handle resolution.

jon: indirection table sounds good. keep table compact and avoid extra loads on hot path: pointer if resident, indirection index otherwise. updates from residency_manager swap in pointer atomically.

mira: fragmentation worry: delaying placement increases scatter. suggest a compact_candidates(range_id, urgency) hint so residency_manager can cluster allocations.

evan: compaction should be cooperative and bounded. kernels can mark long-lived pinned anchors; residency_manager treats anchors as immovable and compacts around them. background compactor migrates ephemeral ranges.

mira: another cross-cutting: packing/quantization-aware placement. 4-bit packed tensors benefit from colocated pages. propose a packing_group tag on alloc handles so residency_manager can co-locate/stripe pages for better cache locality.

tariq: ++ packing_group. need experiments to measure eviction locality and kvcache hit-rate.

mira: action items: 1) i'll prototype handle indirection + sync ensure_resident path (PR next sprint). 2) jon to spec watermark/backpressure integration with host-pool. 3) evan to draft compaction anchor semantics and packing_group tag.

infra-bot: deploybot: CI queued for mira/allocator-proto branch.

mira: also want a metric: residency_ensure_latency tagged by policy (sync|hint|defer) and outcome (hit|miss|evict_fallback). will let us tune default policy.

jon: i'll add the API sketch and a short appendix on indirection table atomics to the RFC.

tariq: looks good to me. thanks mira. :thumbsup:

mira: thanks all, will post benchmarks (small-batch p99 before/after) with the PR.
